title: To establish new ZIP Codes for certain communities, and for other purposes.
short_title: To establish new ZIP Codes for certain communities, and for other purposes.
committees: S-Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee: Referred To 2025-07-22 || H-Oversight and Government Reform Committee: Referred To 2025-01-23 -> Markup By 2025-05-21
committee_votes: Oversight and Government Reform Committee 2025-05-21: Ordered reported - 42-1
latest_action: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.
summary: This bill requires the U.S Postal Service to designate a single, unique ZIP Code for each of the following 14 communities: Eastvale, California Scotland, Connecticut Castle Pines, Colorado Silver Cliff, Colorado Hollywood, Florida Miami Lakes, Florida Ocoee, Florida Urbandale, Iowa Franklin, Wisconsin Greenfield, Wisconsin Village of Caledonia, Wisconsin Village of Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin Village of Somers, Wisconsin Mills, Wyoming

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
